newsitem.title: POLAND: Rafako jumps 9.7 pct on press report.
newsitem.headline: Rafako jumps 9.7 pct on press report.

text.p: Polish industrial boilermaker Rafako SA surged 9.7 percent to 19.2 zlotys in moderate trade on a newspaper report that it had finished work on a contract possibly worth about $30 million, traders said.
"The company's financial stand might improve after the contract is concluded," one trader said.
The contract to build a boiler for Warsaw heating and power generating plant Zeran was signed in 1993, the report said.
Traders said the stock might continue its gains in the next few sessions.
